knowledge_gaps: The residual uses shared item embeddings, so joint training changes the backbone after initialization. Branch removal measures dependence within the trained model; it does not recover an independently trained SASRec baseline.

Reproduction details remain unspecified: scalar learning rate and regularization, embedding scaling, checkpoint selection, and allocation of the 43,200 GPU-second budget across four variants and four datasets.

The definition alternates between the last five nonpadding items and the last five positions. These differ under masking probes. Whole-prefix pooling also needs to specify whether its scope is the truncated model input or the complete history.

The originality assessment lacks comparison with established combinations of long-term preferences and recent-item signals. Shared-embedding similarity and popularity effects could explain gains without demonstrating improved modeling of current interests.
Paired bootstrap intervals do not address repeated validation selection. The report needs a prespecified comparison and checkpoint policy, with exploratory findings clearly identified.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify prior art and whether the proposed contribution is primarily an empirical control study; reassess originality against established short-term and long-term recommendation models.
follow_up_queries.query: How do FPMC, FOSSIL (FactOrized Sequential Prediction with Item SImilarity ModeLs), and recent sequential recommendation models combine pooled history embeddings, recent-item signals, and learned scalar weights? Compare their scoring functions with SASRec plus a zero-initialized scalar recent-five-item mean residual.

follow_up_queries.reason: Investigate optimization and shortcut explanations before attributing validation gains to useful recency.
follow_up_queries.query: In sequential recommendation with tied input and output item embeddings, how do embedding norms, item popularity, residual feature scaling, and zero-initialized residual gates affect training and ranking? What controlled ablations distinguish recent-history information gains from score calibration and optimization effects?

follow_up_queries.reason: Make model selection and uncertainty reporting credible under a small fixed validation sample and a shared compute budget.
follow_up_queries.query: What evaluation practices address validation overfitting when comparing sequential recommender variants and selecting checkpoints using fixed sampled HR@10 candidates? Consider 200 users per dataset, four equally weighted datasets, paired bootstrap intervals, repeated model selection, and compute-matched training comparisons.
